checkpoint: P7B Pulsar caller-owned window-title surface discovery
purpose: Determine whether Pulsar exposes an exact current-window title that is discriminating between two temporary caller-owned JavaScript documents and can be reconstructed deterministically from caller-owned file identity, while rechecking the P7A JavaScript and UTF-8 semantic-gap plus local-Vision exact-match observations. Discovery-only; no visual action and no promotion.
requiredObservations: two distinct temporary JavaScript documents are opened in one clean Pulsar session
Computer Control window.getCurrent returns a non-empty current-window title for both documents
the title change is characterized without assuming a title format in advance
a stable template may use only caller-owned FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, PARENT_PATH or PARENT_NAME substitutions
if caller-derivable, materializing the same template for each document reproduces both exact titles
window-title exact verifies the positive current title and rejects the prior document title
JavaScript and UTF-8 remain structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET CLICK gaps before local Vision selection
local Vision is selected at most once and only after semantic gap classification
no click, keyboard editing or visual action delivery occurs
safety: Pulsar must not already be running; otherwise the session is BLOCKED
both documents are created under one temporary directory and contain test-owned data only
no user document is read or modified
no pointer or keyboard action is delivered after app launch/activation
no raw semantic snapshot, screenshot, OCR payload or coordinates are persisted
the test initiates no external network request
Pulsar, Computer Control runtime and temporary files are cleaned up
PASS means DIAGNOSTIC_OBSERVED only and does not ship a built-in contract or skill

onPass.next: If the Pulsar title is caller-derivable, exact, discriminating and JavaScript or UTF-8 remains an exact visual gap, choose at most one target and run a separate non-destructive action/postcondition discovery before any normal-agent-loop validation or promotion. If title identity is not suitable, do not weaken exact matching; search for another deterministic Pulsar editor-surface identity or another supported application.
